simple.summary: גַּבְלֻת (gabluth) means a twisted chain or lace First listed occurrence: Exod 28 22.

definitions.full: H1383. gabluth גַּבְלֻת noun feminine twisting — גַּבְלֻת שֹׁת שַׁרְ Exod 28:22 , גּ ׳שַׁרְשְׁרֹת 39:15 (both P), cords of twisting , i.e. (well or tightly) twisted cords.
